escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, The Cheese Prank That Ended In Tragedy 😢, by Zack D. Films, with over 4 thousand comments.
In second place, Dream Needs To Stop Lying, by Karl Jobst, with over 8 thousand comments.
And number one: How you invented the door, by Odd Tilt, with over 9 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
